verified_contracts.finding: Initial geometric S raw carriers are replaced with missing sentinels before mask prompts, state features, B/I correction and O/T domain creation; no S image or region term enters PnP. Registered geometry and final rigid S projection are permitted geometry operations.

B measures target/background transitions; I measures current RGB gradient lines. Initial registered model supplies guide directions only. Unsupported intersections preserve the original visible prediction and are not counted as corrections.
Corrected B/I xy and covariance are deep-copied before solving and preserved as observed readouts. The rigid projection readout is separate and the mixed corner readout is explicitly nonrigid.

Corrected-only P3P/SQPNP roots and global rotations are initializations; SLSQP changes all six SE3 parameters with every O/T inequality present in each branch. This is not scoring only a fixed old pose list.
Per-corner ellipse/box/halfplane constraints are checked individually; O/T centers are never precise point correspondences and constraint violations are not averaged away.
Failed joint solving preserves B/I observations and may project only S from an explicitly named seed/coarse fallback. Unresolved O/T/U are not reported as joint solved output.

Row-coordinate physical conversion X_native @ Q with Q=R_cf.T @ R_physical is correct; the reference uses X_reference @ Qref and the preexisting native-to-reference mapping. No pose candidate is selected with GT during prediction.

Driver includes all95 primary frames (CAL46/TEST49) and3 separately marked real RGB crops. Postseal primary pose metrics include every primary row and fallbacks; compatible visible pixel metrics are explicitly a conditional subset. Coordinate label access in the study begins after prediction/protocol/source/crop seals.

Runtime and study predict take current RGB, raw native image predictions, registered K/model/coarse pose and frozen CAL-trained models only. They do not receive per-image coordinate targets or human state labels. Crop expected-state metadata is not passed as oracle states; source GT transforms occur only in postseal score. CAL target use for O uncertainty training is separate and declared.

resolved_findings.finding: BI-only arm now handles None seed with `or {}` and checks R/t rather than a nonexistent available field.
Rejected-result OT count now uses the domain bundle length rather than the number of nested T-branch audit records.
Preregistration, crop prediction inputs and actual crop files are explicitly bound in the study protocol and checked before scoring.

Study binds Tiny/SAM ownership separately using the original mask descriptor. New geometry-spatial descriptor also binds Tiny/backbone device; NON_S_RGB26 generic fallback still requires an explicit mask/provider contract.

GEOMETRY family now reports projected_points_sampled=True, gated projected_RGB_queried_ids, and projected_coordinates_used_as_observations=False; initial conditional RGB guidance is separated from observations and final pose sampling.

Every B/I now carries both the seed-projection movement guard and an individual absolute Mahalanobis measurement norm<=3 guard in every SLSQP constraint evaluation. Final/candidate/seed audits report both guards and explicitly disclaim calibrated probability. API rejects inconsistent B/I seeds for S fallback and names the coarse fallback instead.

limitations: S is fixed from the coarse registered geometry. A wrong initial pose/phase can exclude a genuinely visible point; S RGB-zero is a structural guarantee about this fixed mask, not a guarantee of correct physical visibility.

Only7 RGB-eligible CAL external-O errors across2 recordings fit the empirical max radius;2 more actual CAL O raw predictions are outside and receive broad fallback. No95% joint or image-conditional probability guarantee is claimed.

Actual O state generalization remains unverified until full sealed TEST49 state-confusion/pose scoring. Earlier families failed useful O inference; the third CAL-only bounded head has encouraging crossfit results but only7 O labels.
Only3 natural CAL records have >=2 real external O, and TEST has no natural multi-O records. Natural human T labels are absent.

Three actual RGB crops were chosen from raw image queries before coordinate-GT access; expected T is not physical T proof. The crop pipeline translates frozen upstream q/K/pose and does not rerun the backbone. Physical T is checked only after prediction sealing.

Unknown-side T enumerates an outside-canvas union. The256 branch cap returns explicit unresolved failure rather than silently solving a partial set. Finite multistart local optimization is not a global feasibility or uniqueness proof.
Historical TEST has been reused and historical pose targets are derived references, so this study cannot establish unseen-test or SOTA performance.

B/I covariance and the per-point Mahalanobis norm<=3 budget are declared heuristic noise assumptions, not a calibrated 3-sigma coverage guarantee. Report measurement residual and guard failure/fallback counts.
